exposure: middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA-PI) lower than the 5th percentile (<p5)
outcome: Presence of thick meconium at delivery
Need for admission to the neonatal intensive care
finding: In prolonged pregnancies, an MCA-PI < 5th percentile is related to meconium emission at the time of delivery, but is not associated with an increased risk of other adverse perinatal outcomes.
